eli.title: OSU - Conditional admission for international students

fy.title: OSU - Freshman admission requirements and codes

test_policy.notes: Students can apply without consideration of a test score and be admitted on a full review of the high school transcript. International 'assured admission' is stated as high school GPA 3.0+ (4.0 scale, recalculated by OSU) plus the English requirement; no SAT/ACT is listed. Scores raise scholarship awards (ACT/SAT/IELTS/TOEFL/Duolingo/PTE grid).

requirements.notes: International application fee is $90 (domestic $50). OSU application opens July 1; Common App opens Aug. 1; submit only one. The application is also the scholarship application. Required uploads: passport ID page, English test, transcripts (OSU does not accept third-party credential evaluations), financial guarantee form plus bank letter. A leadership and involvement resume is needed for full scholarship consideration.

deadlines.label: International fall application deadline (applicants not living in the U.S.)
deadlines.notes: Applicants currently living in the U.S. have July 1. The page lists 'Fall: June 1' without printing a year; taken as the fall 2027 cycle. Spring is Nov. 1 (Dec. 1 if living in the U.S.).

deadlines.label: Early Opportunity Scholarship deadline (freshmen)
deadlines.notes: Complete application incl. leadership and involvement resume, and submit test scores, for maximum scholarship consideration.

deadlines.label: Priority scholarship deadline (freshmen)
deadlines.notes: Full scholarship consideration requires all materials by this date; later applications are considered only if funds remain. Absolute scholarship deadline is Aug. 13.

deadlines.label: College Decision Date (enrollment deposit $300, $250 refundable until May 1)
deadlines.notes: Enrollment deposit opens Dec. 1; some scholarships must be accepted by May 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for graduates of an accredited high school where English is the primary language of instruction in a country where English is the primary language, and for students who attended English-speaking U.S. high schools for 2+ years. TOEFL/IELTS scores are valid two years. Conditional admission is offered to students who meet everything except English (see notes on the English rows).

english.notes: Page gives 'iBT TOEFL Internet-Based Score 3.5+' (the 1-6 scale) and does not list an old 0-120 minimum. Conditional admission minimum 3.0. TOEFL send code 6546. Institutional-test TOEFL not accepted.
Accepted from fall 2024. Conditional admission minimum 85.
PTE Academic. Conditional admission minimum 36. iTEP Academic 3.5 (conditional 3.0) is also accepted but is not a listed test here.

aid.notes: International Achievement Freshmen Scholarships (automatic with the application, partial tuition waiver) range $5,000-$15,000 per year; the grid is by GPA and test (e.g. IELTS 6.0 / SAT 1160-1220 with 3.0-3.24 GPA = $9,500; 'GPA only, no test' awards $6,000-$9,000). Alumni legacy $5,000. College/department scholarships vary. CDS H6: need-based aid is also available to nonresidents (169 recipients, avg $10,492). The admissions page says $7,000-$15,000 and the scholarship page says $5,000-$15,000.

majors.program: Nursing (BSN, College of Education and Human Sciences)
majors.notes: Students are admitted to BSN and moved to Professional Nursing only if admitted through a secondary application.

majors.program: Music, Music Education, Acting, Musical Theatre
majors.notes: Freshman admission requires a separate audition process with the department.

toefl.note: TOEFL DI code on the international page.

ielts.note: No institution code is listed; copies of official scores are accepted if verifiable online.

tier_notes.engineering: Editorial judgment: established ABET-accredited engineering college (CEAT) in the roughly 41-100 national band.
tier_notes.business: Editorial judgment: Spears School of Business, AACSB-accredited, roughly 41-100 band.
